verdict.rationale: The GST system runs its own Developer Portal at developer.gst.gov.in with Register and Login entry points. That suggests a first-party system-to-system API channel with a published enrollment path, but the pack shows only the portal's home-page labels. The Offline Tool and GST Practitioner enrollment are manual or human-intermediary paths, not machine rails, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of the API channel itself (endpoints, system accounts, provider/transmitter program such as approved intermediaries), the eligibility and enrollment steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that third-party software can actually transact.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
